name: One-Obstruction PC-Minor Basis for Hypercubes
statement: A finite partial cube is a hypercube if and only if it has no pc-minor isomorphic to $P_3$; the obstruction is pc-minimal.
proof: The avoidance equivalence is the cited one-obstruction theorem. The graph $P_3$ is not a cube, while every proper projection, conditioning, or further pc-minor is $K_1$ or $K_2$, both hypercubes.
